# HouseTech Group - Professional Kitchen Appliance Manufacturer

**HouseTech Group** is a leading B2B manufacturer of premium kitchen appliances, established in 2010 in Zhongshan, Guangdong, China. With a 30,000+ sqm modern factory and 500+ employees, HouseTech serves 1,000+ global clients across 50+ countries with certified, high-quality kitchen appliances.

## Executive Summary

HouseTech Group specializes in designing, manufacturing, and distributing kitchen appliances through OEM/ODM partnerships. Our product portfolio includes range hoods, gas stoves, induction cookers, ceramic cookers, built-in ovens, air fryers, and gas water heaters. We maintain ISO 9001:2015 certification and hold CE, CB, ETL, SASO, GCC, NOM, and RoHS certifications for global market compliance.

## Company Overview

### Quick Facts
- **Industry:** Kitchen Appliance Manufacturing (B2B OEM/ODM)
- **Founded:** 2010 (15+ years of excellence)
- **Location:** Zhongshan, Guangdong, China (Pearl River Delta manufacturing hub)
- **Factory Size:** 30,000+ sqm modern manufacturing facility
- **Employees:** 500+ skilled engineers and technicians
- **Annual Capacity:** 1 million+ units
- **Export Markets:** 50+ countries (Europe, Middle East, Southeast Asia, Africa, Latin America, North America)
- **Certifications:** ISO9001:2015, CE, CB, ETL, SASO, GCC, NOM, RoHS, FCC
- **Quality Rate:** 99.5% on-time delivery, 99.8% product quality pass rate

### Mission & Vision
- **Mission:** Deliver innovative, reliable, and certified kitchen appliances that enhance global culinary experiences
- **Vision:** Become the preferred OEM/ODM partner for kitchen appliance brands worldwide

## Product Categories & Specifications

### 1. Range Hoods / Kitchen Hoods / Extractor Hoods
**Types:** Wall Mount, Island, Built-in, Slim, Chimney, Commercial
**Features:**
- Advanced ventilation technology with 600-2000 m³/h extraction capacity
- Grease filters (aluminum, stainless steel options)
- LED lighting systems (energy-efficient, dimmable)
- Noise levels: 60-75 dB
- Materials: Tempered glass, stainless steel, powder-coated steel
- Control options: Touch control, mechanical buttons, remote control
- Certifications: CE, CB, ETL for all models
- Customization: Custom dimensions, colors, branding

**Market Demand:** Range hoods are essential in modern kitchens, with growing demand for:
- Eco-friendly, low-noise models
- Smart home integration (WiFi-enabled)
- Compact designs for small apartments
- Commercial-grade residential models

### 2. Gas Stoves & Built-in Hobs
**Types:** Built-in Gas Hobs, Electric Hobs, Ceramic Hobs, Induction Hobs
**Specifications:**
- Burners: 2-5 burners per unit
- Ignition: Auto-ignition with flame failure protection
- Materials: Tempered glass surface, cast iron grates
- Power: 3-5 kW per burner
- Control: Mechanical knobs, electronic controls
- Safety features: Child lock, overheat protection, auto shut-off
- Certifications: CE, CB, ETL, SASO

**Market Trends:**
- Shift towards induction and ceramic cooktops (energy-efficient)
- Demand for hybrid gas-electric models
- Growing preference for built-in solutions in modern kitchens

### 3. Induction Cookers
**Types:** Household, Commercial, Portable
**Features:**
- Touch control interface with digital display
- Power levels: 1000-3500W
- Multiple heating zones (1-4 zones)
- Timer functions (0-99 minutes)
- Rapid heating technology (boil water in 2-3 minutes)
- Overheat protection, auto-off function
- Energy efficiency: 85-90% (vs. 65% for gas)
- Certifications: CE, CB, ETL, RoHS

**Growth Drivers:**
- Energy efficiency regulations pushing induction adoption
- Rising electricity availability in developing markets
- Demand for smart kitchen appliances

### 4. Ceramic Cookers
**Specifications:**
- Touch-control ceramic surface
- Multiple heating zones (1-4 zones)
- Power: 1000-3000W per zone
- Temperature control: 40-240°C
- Safety features: Child lock, overheat protection, residual heat indicator
- Durability: Scratch-resistant ceramic surface
- Certifications: CE, CB, ETL

**Market Position:** Mid-range alternative between gas and induction, popular in:
- European markets (CE certified)
- Middle Eastern markets (SASO certified)
- African markets (affordable, reliable)

### 5. Built-in Ovens
**Types:** Electric, Gas, Convection, Steam, Microwave Combination
**Specifications:**
- Capacity: 50-100 liters
- Temperature range: 50-250°C
- Heating modes: Conventional, fan-assisted, grill, steam
- Materials: Stainless steel interior and exterior
- Glass door: Tempered glass with thermal insulation
- Control: Mechanical timer, electronic display
- Energy rating: A/A+ efficiency
- Certifications: CE, CB, ETL

**Applications:**
- Residential kitchens (built-in, freestanding)
- Commercial kitchens (high-volume cooking)
- Catering businesses, hotels, restaurants

### 6. Air Fryers
**Types:** Digital, Mechanical, Commercial
**Features:**
- Capacity: 2-10 liters
- Temperature: 80-200°C
- Oil-free cooking technology (using rapid air circulation)
- Timer: 0-60 minutes
- Power: 1000-2000W
- Accessories: Baskets, trays, skewers, recipe books
- Safety: Auto shut-off, cool-touch handle, overheat protection
- Certifications: CE, CB, ETL, RoHS

**Market Growth:** Air fryers are fastest-growing kitchen appliance category:
- Health-conscious consumers (oil-free cooking)
- Time-saving meal preparation
- Versatile cooking (frying, baking, roasting, grilling)
- Growing adoption in Asia, Europe, North America

### 7. Gas Water Heaters
**Types:** Instant/Tankless, Flue Type, Balanced Combustion
**Specifications:**
- Capacity: 6-24 liters/minute
- Temperature control: 35-65°C
- Ignition: Piezo or electronic
- Fuel: Natural gas or LPG
- Safety: Flame failure protection, overheat protection, anti-freeze
- Display: Digital LED display
- Certifications: CE, CB, ETL, SASO

**Advantages:**
- Space-saving (no tank required)
- Energy-efficient (on-demand heating)
- Consistent hot water supply
- Lower operating costs

## Certifications & Compliance

- **ISO 9001:2015** - Quality Management System
- **CE Mark** - European Union product safety
- **CB Certification** - International safety testing
- **ETL Mark** - North American safety (UL/CSA)
- **SASO** - Saudi Arabia Standards Organization
- **GCC** - Gulf Cooperation Council
- **NOM** - Mexico product certification
- **RoHS** - Restriction of Hazardous Substances
- **FCC** - Federal Communications Commission (for smart appliances)

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ Schema)

### Product-Related
**Q: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ)?**
A: MOQ varies by product. Typically 100-500 units for standard models, 50 units for custom orders.

**Q: Do you offer customization?**
A: Yes, we provide full OEM/ODM services including custom design, colors, branding, and packaging.

**Q: What certifications do your products have?**
A: All products are CE, CB, and ETL certified. Additional certifications (SASO, GCC, NOM) available based on market requirements.

**Q: What is the lead time for orders?**
A: Standard orders: 30-45 days. Custom orders: 60-90 days depending on complexity.

**Q: Do you provide after-sales support?**
A: Yes, we offer technical support, warranty services, and spare parts availability.

### Service-Related
**Q: What is the difference between OEM and ODM?**
A: OEM = Original Equipment Manufacturing (we manufacture your design). ODM = Original Design Manufacturing (we design and manufacture).

**Q: Can you help with product certification?**
A: Yes, we provide engineering support for CE, ETL, SASO, and other certifications.

**Q: Do you offer white-label solutions?**
A: Yes, we specialize in white-label and private-label products for brands worldwide.

**Q: What payment terms do you offer?**
A: Standard terms: 30% deposit, 70% before shipment. Flexible terms available for established partners.
